ns2:section.sectionText: Introduction to Data Science & Python for Finance introduces the principles of data science, analytics workflow, and how to work with large data sets. At the end of this course you will be comfortable using Python as part of your analytics toolkit while applying essential data analysis techniques to solve real world finance-related problems.Areas of application in Finance include: Sentiment Analysis, Time Series Analysis, Risk Management, Segmentation Analysis, and Machine Learning and Deep Learning. Course is restricted to MSF students and preference will be given to new MSF students.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign. Restricted to MS:Finance -UIUC, MS: Finance Cost Rec -UIUC, MS: Finance - UIUC, or MS: Finance Cost Rec - UIUC.
